title: Listing Validator Rulepack v1
description: Declarative marketplace rulepack consumed by the Listing Readiness Validator addon. The addon ships a closed set of validators (engine operators). A profile that only tunes an existing validator can be added without republishing the addon; a profile that needs a brand-new validator requires an engine (addon) update.

schema_version.description: Structure version of this file. The addon rejects a schema_version it does not understand.

engine_version.description: Minimum validator engine the pack requires. The addon rejects a pack whose engine_version is newer than the engine it implements.

pack_version.description: Human-readable content version, e.g. semantic version. Shown in the audit result and settings.

published_at.description: ISO-8601 publish timestamp for display only.

validator.description: Closed set of engine operators implemented by the addon. Any other value is rejected.
